scope: Procedural mesh persistence only; root controlled scene comparison supports stale rendered mesh buffers while CPU bounds were current
contract: public static Mesh MvpMeshPersistence.Store(string assetPath, Mesh generated)
preserves: Existing mesh object and asset GUID, index format, vertex attributes, UV0-7 values, submesh topology and indices
refresh: Clear(false), explicit channel setters, RecalculateBounds, UploadMeshData(false), SetDirty; transient generated mesh destroyed
retained: Manual chunking and disabled automatic static flags
limitations: No source geometry/DEM/Blender regeneration or Unity calls; actual GPU capture validation belongs to root
